caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron balcony railing rendered in black ink on a beige or off-white background. The railing consists of four vertically oriented panels, each featuring a symmetrical, ornate design with flowing, curved lines and decorative scrollwork. Each panel contains a central oval motif surrounded by elaborate patterns resembling stylized leaves or petals. The panels are connected by vertical bars with small knotted details and topped by a horizontal bar with a repetitive looping pattern. The floor or base of the railing is shown as a solid rectangular block with a slightly textured appearance. The bottom of the drawing includes a label that reads "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" in capital letters. The overall composition is contained within a rectangular border, and all lines and details are monochromatic, using varying thicknesses for emphasis.
title: Cast Iron Window Balcony
